facts: The paper presents a corpus-based supervised word sense disambiguation system for Dutch.
The word sense disambiguation system combines statistical classification with linguistic information.
The paper introduces a lemma-based approach instead of building individual classifiers per ambiguous wordform.
The lemma-based method clusters all inflected forms of an ambiguous word in one classifier.
Clustering all inflected forms of an ambiguous word in one classifier augments the training material available to the algorithm.
Testing the lemma-based model on the Dutch Senseval-2 test data yields a significant increase in accuracy over the wordform model.
The word sense disambiguation system based on lemmas is smaller.
The word sense disambiguation system based on lemmas is more robust.
The word sense disambiguation system is corpus-based.
The word sense disambiguation system is supervised.
The word sense disambiguation system is for Dutch.
The statistical classification in the system uses maximum entropy.
The word sense disambiguation system uses linguistic information.
The lemma-based approach is a novel method.
The lemma-based model was tested on the Dutch Senseval-2 test data.
entities: corpus-based supervised word sense disambiguation ( WSD ) system
